title: LGTM (Looks Good to Me) - Claude Opus 5.5 music video
description:
LGTM stands for "looks good to me". Lately it's what engineers type on code they never had time to read, because leadership heard AI makes everyone ten times faster and cut the deadlines to match. Review and testing are the first things to go, since neither one shows up on a roadmap slide.

It's something to dance to while you approve it anyway, and a receipt for every executive who will stand up at the postmortem and ask how anyone could have known.

Song: made with Suno v6
Animation: Claude Opus 5.5, in TypeScript and three.js
Direction: Degenerative Pixels
